_about: Owner: reference writer (reference/env-vars and later reference pages). Search all glossary files before you add a term here.

descriptor.short: A Python object that is stored as a class attribute and controls what an attribute read returns, through its __get__ method.
descriptor.long: DeepInfer uses a descriptor, EnvVar, for each environment variable. On the first read it parses the variable and puts the plain value in its own place ({{cite deepinfer/environ.py:44-57}}).

import-time.short: The moment when Python runs the top level of a module for the first time: module code, class bodies and the default values of function arguments.
import-time.long: A value that code reads at import time does not change when you set the variable after the import. See the import-time table on {{link reference/env-vars}}.

monkeypatch.short: A pytest fixture that changes an attribute, a dict item or an environment variable for one test, and puts the old value back after the test.
